title: AID Test Portfolio — Scheduler Parallel Overlay
$comment: producer: aid-test-isolation-experiment.sh (P069 Step 6, proposed) / aid-scheduler-overlay-approve.sh (approved copy); consumer: aid-test-scheduler.sh (Step 5)'s effective-status resolution.
description: The ONLY place an `unknown` -> `safe`/`constrained` promotion is ever recorded. Deliberately SEPARATE from and ADDITIVE to .aid-o/config/test-catalog.yaml — never a modification to P066's own parallel.status field or approval semantics (same authority-resolution pattern as resource_locks in Step 1 and the catalog-approval-boundary reconciliation in Step 11). status:proposed = gitignored, evidence-only (.aid-o/work/test-audits/<id>/scheduler-overlay.proposed.json). status:approved = force-tracked (.aid-o/config/test-scheduler-parallel-overlay.yaml), written only by aid-scheduler-overlay-approve.sh.

overlay.description: At most one entry per run_unit_id — a second promotion for the same run_unit_id supersedes, it never coexists (aid-scheduler-overlay-approve.sh's merge/upsert semantics).

run_unit_id.description: References test-catalog.yaml's run_units[].run_unit_id — never a separately-minted identity.

promoted_status.description: The scheduler NEVER reads this array to demote a unit to unknown/exclusive — only to promote off unknown.

catalog_fingerprint_at_promotion.description: The exact run_units[].runtime.fingerprint this run_unit_id had in the catalog at promotion time — the staleness key aid-test-scheduler.sh's effective-status resolution checks. A promotion whose value no longer matches the CURRENT catalog fingerprint is rejected identically to a missing entry.

evidence_run_id.description: The specific isolation-experiment invocation (Step 6) that produced this promotion.
